html:
Changed

  • Service Xpress charts now list by year, exactly like the fluid tables — the file name is gone from the list and the Update chooser. You only pick a file (and see its name) at the point of choosing the PDF to add or update.

Added

  • The Update button now checks the file you pick. When you replace a year, Hahns makes sure the PDF is the right kind and the right year before saving:
  • Pick a Service Xpress chart while updating a Fluid Capacities year (or vice-versa) → it tells you it’s the wrong kind and asks for the correct one.
  • Pick the wrong year (a 2014 file to update 2013) → it tells you and asks for the 2013 file.
  • Either way you can choose another file without starting over.
